title: Reconstruction of Personally Identifiable Information from Proprietary Data in Supervised Fine-Tuned Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.12264v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Supervised Finetuning (SFT) has become one of the primary methods for adapting a large language model (LLM) with extensive pre-trained knowledge to domain-specific, instruction-following tasks. SFT datasets, composed of instruction-response pairs, often include user-provided information that may contain sensitive data such as personally identifiable information (PII), raising privacy concerns. This paper studies the problem of targeted PII reconstruction from models fine- tuned on proprietary SFT data, in which an adversary attempts to recover PII associated with a specific identity. We construct multi-turn, user-centric Q&A datasets in sensitive domains, specifically medical and legal settings, that incorporate PII to enable realistic evaluation of leakage. translated_title: 从监督微调模型中的专有数据重建个人身份信息
translated_abstract: 监督微调（SFT）已成为将具有广泛预训练知识的大型语言模型（LLM）适应于特定领域、指令遵循任务的主要方法之一。SFT数据集由指令-响应对组成，通常包含用户提供的信息，这些信息可能涉及敏感数据，如个人身份信息（PII），从而引发隐私担忧。本文研究了从在专有SFT数据上微调的模型中针对性地重建PII的问题，其中攻击者试图恢复与特定身份关联的PII。我们在敏感领域（具体为医疗和法律场景）构建了多轮、以用户为中心的问答数据集，并纳入PII以实现对泄漏的现实评估。随后，我们提出了COVA，一种用于基于前缀攻击下针对性PII重建的覆盖感知解码算法。利用COVA，我们研究了可用信息量如何影响重建成功率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种覆盖感知解码算法COVA，用于从监督微调模型中针对性地重建个人身份信息，并通过构建医疗和法律领域的多轮问答数据集来评估隐私泄漏风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a coverage-aware decoding algorithm COVA for targeted PII reconstruction from supervised fine-tuned models and evaluates privacy leakage risks using multi-turn Q&A datasets in medical and legal domains.
